evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and changes test framework node startup logic in `test/functional/test_framework/util.py` and `test_framework/test_node.py`.
rationale: The PR fixes a recurring functional test failure in `interface_ipc*.py` on NetBSD caused by `-ipcbind` file descriptors exceeding the `FD_SETSIZE` (256) limit. This restores passing test signal on NetBSD nightly runs by adjusting framework max connection limits.
